rationale: The agent verified the user via email and looked up the user and order, then attempted to fulfill the modification request and, upon the user’s explicit instruction, proceeded to cancel the order. However, the agent stated that the “full amount has been refunded to your gift card balance immediately,” which is not supported by any tool output and the payment method for the order was not confirmed. The cancellation tool response did not include refund details, and the account only shows a gift card as a payment method option, not proof it funded the order. This constitutes fabricated/unsupported information, violating the requirement to provide correct final information. While the user’s cancellation request was explicit (meeting confirmation), the unsupported refund statement causes the conversation to fail the pass bar.
